title: 第9章 好兄弟
content_zh:
第9章好兄弟
宦官一时之间六神无主，浑身颤栗起来，小声辩解道：“陛下不是说……二十鞭子狠狠地打吗？”
朱棣更是勃然大怒，厉声大喝道：“你们这些狗东西，平日里行刑，便晓得糊弄朕，不是有假打和真打之分吗？”
这宦官彻底的傻眼了。
分明当初陛下大怒的时候，斩钉截铁的要求狠狠的打的。
朱棣眼里掠过了一丝急切：“现在人如何？”
“奴婢自是不敢让人伤了他的筋骨，只是……只是……这鞭子还算打的结实，倒是见了血！”
朱棣：“……”
宦官早已吓得身如筛糠，瑟瑟发抖了。
他哪里知道陛下当初盛怒的时候，一边骂张軏的娘，一面吩咐着狠狠的打，实则却只是想吓唬吓唬，顺道让张軏那小子吃点苦头呢。
朱棣道：“一个娃娃，你们怎么下的了这样的狠手。”
宦官：“……”
朱棣眼中闪动着几分担忧，口里道：“还不快传御医去，让太医院的人，火速去张家看一看。”
宦官如蒙大赦，立即道：“是，是……”
说着，连滚带爬的跑了。
朱棣却是背着手，不安地在殿中转着圈圈，他时而低头沉思，时而喃喃自语。
“世美啊世美，这是你儿太糊涂啊，你看看他荒唐成什么样子……哎……”（张玉字：世美）
他念着念着，好像是为自己辩解似的。
可突然一种不安越发的强烈，猛然道：“来，来人……给朕备马！”
…………

张安世来到了张家，这张家的府邸很是气派。
荣国公张玉虽然战死，可是他的几个儿子，尤其是大儿子张辅，却很快得到了永乐皇帝的重用，如今已位列朝班，年轻轻的便被委任为五军都督府都指挥使同知。
不过张安世没有贸然进去，而是小心翼翼地先让张三去拍门，先问问张軏的兄长张辅在不在家。
至于原因嘛……可能是他的名声有点不好，根据他原来身体主人的记忆，反正那张辅见了他，就总是一副臭脸。
没一会，张三去而复返，兴冲冲地道：“少爷，问过了，张同知还在都督府当值呢。”
张安世直接舒了口气，颔首道：“好了，知道了，你在外头等着，望风。”
张三精神抖擞地道：“少爷，我懂的。”
主仆二人竟有默契。
张安世不禁想，莫非当初那个张安世……也是这般如过街老鼠一样的吗？
他一溜烟的进了张府，跟着下人的后头，果然在卧房里见到了张軏。
张軏是被人抬回来的，唧唧哼哼地趴在被褥上，嗷嗷叫了老半天，结果发现自己的祖母和娘亲一听自己在学里顽皮，让陛下收拾了，居然丢下了一句有愧祖宗便不理睬了。
一时之间，张軏便不嚎叫了，只唧唧哼哼地撅着屁股，一动不敢动。
这时，张安世左右张望，见里头没有张家的亲眷在，才一溜烟的小跑进来，口里道：“我来啦，我来探望你啦。”
张軏一听，身躯一颤，只可怜他这一颤，便牵扯到了伤口，于是龇牙咧嘴，又唧唧哼哼起来。
不过张軏却觉得是意外之喜，兴高采烈地道：“大哥，你竟来了。”
张安世到了榻前，看他趴在床榻上的‘奇怪’姿势，不禁唏嘘道：“三弟你受苦啦，我一见你受罚，便立即赶回家去，为你寻医访药。”
张軏一听，眼眶里便有泪水团团打转：“我祖母和我娘理也不理我，只晓得骂我不争气。上午挨鞭子的时候，见大哥走了，还以为大哥也不想睬我了。谁想到大哥竟记挂着我的伤……大哥心里有我，我真的……”
说着，泪水便夺眶而出。
张安世同情地看了一眼张軏。
人傻好像是傻了点，不过……是个实在人，能处。

张安世将自己的瓷瓶取了出来，道：“你这虽是皮外伤，可若是感染了，却也是要命的。这是我寻访来的神药，你一定要记得用，涂抹在患处就好了，知道了吗？“
张軏一脸感动，小鸡啄米般地点头：“你能来看我，我的伤便好了一半。我……我没了爹，兄长对我又严厉，只有大哥对我好。”
张安世：“……”
张軏又道：“二哥就没义气，到现在也不见踪影。”
张安世便安慰他道：“你二哥不一样，他在学里也挨了罚，只怕回了家，他爹还要打他一顿，他现在正挨揍呢，自己都顾不上。”
张軏听罢，似乎觉得很有道理，于是破涕为笑：“对呀，我竟忘了……”
张安世又嘱咐张軏一定要记得用药，说了一些发炎之类生涩难懂的话。
不过张軏只是唧唧哼哼，也不知他有没有记下。
张安世没办法，只好将装了药的瓷瓶搁一边。
却在这个时候，两个仆从不约而同地冲了进来，其中一个便是张三，还有一个，则是张軏的书童。
二人异口同声道：“张同知（大少爷）来了……”
张軏气不打一处来，咒骂道：“来了就来了，号丧什么，哎哟哟，哎哟哟……”
张安世却本能地生出了一种恐惧的情绪，就好像……从前那个张安世刻在骨子里的东西发作了一般，下意识地道：“兄弟保重，我先走一步。”
一刻都不敢再待，张安世一溜烟的便跑了。
只留下张軏张大嘴巴，竟连哼哼也忘了。
张安世也不想跑，他还想维持一下自己作为男人和皇亲的光辉形象。
可他这双腿不知咋的，就是不听使唤。
张辅在历史上，是永乐朝的名将，除此之外，此人脾气很坏，嫉恶如仇。
于是，张安世匆匆出了张軏的卧房，刚想要夺门而逃，那张軏的仆从道：“不能走这边，我家大少爷已到前堂了。”
“我不怕他。”张安世骂骂咧咧道。

这话说着，他却往侧门走去，只可惜这里是内宅，所谓的侧门，其实是长年紧闭的，还上了锁，张安世无奈，只得寻了一处矮墙，翻墙而出。
从墙上一跃而下，却骤然听到有人大呼：“是哪里的小贼。”
张安世惊魂未定，错愕抬头起来，却见一小队人马恰好在这墙外巡过去。
为首之人和后头的扈从都骑着高头大马。
而骑在高头大马的那壮汉子，肤色略黑，续着长髯，一对蚕眉下的眼睛顾盼自雄。
张安世立即道：“与你何干。”
马上的汉子听罢，勃然大怒，手中舞着马鞭：“将他拿下。”
后头几个扈从个个龙精虎猛，便要催马上前。
张安世立即道：“我不是小贼，我是这宅里子弟的同窗，他犯了病，我来探望的。”
马上的人虎目只微微阖着，鞭子一横，阻止了后头扈从的动作。
来人正是朱棣，朱棣心里颇有些不安，原本只是想给张軏一点苦头吃，可听说人都打的昏死过去，这才料到可能出手重了一些。
他是马上得天下的皇帝，倒也不遵守什么礼法，心里焦急之下，便穿了便衣出宫来探望。
等他经过这里，正好就看到张安世跳墙下来。
说起来，朱棣和张安世也算是亲戚，可朱棣不太喜欢朱高炽，对张安世也没有过多的厚爱，自然也不曾谋面。
张安世的样子，一看就不是贼人，毕竟光天化日的翻墙，而且这少年人肤色白皙，穿着的也是绫罗绸缎，一看就是贵公子的模样，怎么可能做贼。
朱棣脸色虽是微微一沉，不过此时，他却耐心下来。
这人是张軏的朋友，而且还已探问过病情了。
朱棣道：“你是张軏的朋友？你叫什么？”
张安世见朱棣随口说出张軏的名字，倒不意外，张家是靖难出身，张英虽然战死，却有不少靖难的勋贵与张家关系匪浅，眼前这个人……怕也是其中一位。
张安世道：“还能是哪个，我行不更名，坐不改姓，你叫我郭得甘好了。”

朱棣脑子里搜寻着张軏是否有这样的同窗，不过很快他便没心思计较了，却是道：“张軏伤势如何？”
“他是我郭得甘的兄弟，自然也是一条硬汉子，应该死不了。”
朱棣：“……”
content_en:
Chapter 9 Good Brothers
The eunuch was at a loss for a moment, his whole body trembled, and he defended in a low voice: "Didn't Your Majesty say... give him a severe beating with twenty lashes?"
Zhu Di became furious and shouted: "You guys, you know how to fool me when you carry out executions on weekdays. Aren't there fake beatings and real beatings?"
The eunuch was completely dumbfounded.
It is clear that when His Majesty was furious, he categorically demanded that he be beaten severely.
A hint of urgency flashed in Zhu Di's eyes: "How are you now?"
"I don't dare to let anyone hurt his bones, but...it's just...this whip is pretty strong, but it's bloody!"
Zhu Di: "..."
The eunuch was already so frightened that his body was like chaff and he was trembling.
Little did he know that when His Majesty was so angry, he was scolding Zhang Fu's mother and ordering her to be beaten severely, but in fact he just wanted to scare her and make Zhang Fu suffer a little.
Zhu Di said: "How could you do such a cruel thing to a baby?"
Eunuch: "..."
Zhu Di's eyes flashed with worry, and he said: "Why don't you send the imperial doctor quickly and ask the people from the Taiyuan Hospital to go to Zhang's house to take a look."
The eunuch seemed to have been pardoned and immediately said: "Yes, yes..."
As he said that, he rolled and crawled away.
Zhu Di, on the other hand, was circling around the hall uneasily with his hands behind his back. Sometimes he lowered his head in deep thought and sometimes murmured to himself.
"Shimei, Shimei, your son is too confused. Look at how ridiculous he is... ugh..." (Zhang Yu's subtitle: Shimei)
He thought about it as if to defend himself.
But suddenly a feeling of uneasiness became stronger and stronger, and he suddenly said: "Come on, someone... prepare my horse for me!"
…………
Zhang Anshi came to the Zhang family. The mansion of this family was very grand.
Although Rong Guogong Zhang Yu died in battle, several of his sons, especially the eldest son Zhang Fu, quickly gained the favor of Emperor Yongle. Now they are in the imperial court, and the young ones were appointed as Tongzhi, the commander of the Commander-in-Chief of the Fifth Army.
However, Zhang Anshi did not go in rashly, but carefully asked Zhang San to knock on the door first and ask Zhang Fu's brother Zhang Fu if he was at home.
As for the reason... maybe his reputation is a bit bad. According to the memory of his original body owner, Zhang Fu always had a bad face when he saw him.
After a while, Zhang San came back and said happily: "Master, I asked, Zhang Tongzhi is still on duty at the Governor's Mansion."
Zhang Anshi breathed a sigh of relief, nodded and said, "Okay, I understand. You wait outside and look out for the wind."
Zhang San said energetically: "Master, I understand."
There is a tacit understanding between the master and the servant.
Zhang Anshi couldn't help but wonder, could it be that Zhang Anshi back then... was also like a rat crossing the street?
He entered the Zhang Mansion in a flash, followed the servants, and sure enough he saw Zhang Fu in the bedroom.
Zhang Fu was carried back. He groaned and lay down on the quilt, moaning for a long time. He found that his grandmother and mother heard that he was naughty in school and asked His Majesty to clean him up. They actually ignored him with the words "I feel sorry for my ancestors".
For a moment, Zhang Fu stopped howling. He just hummed and stuck his butt out, not daring to move.
At this time, Zhang Anshi looked around and saw that no relatives of the Zhang family were inside, so he trotted in and said, "I'm here, I'm here to visit you."
When Zhang Fu heard this, his body trembled. It was pitiful that his trembling affected his wound, so he bared his teeth and started to chirp again.
However, Zhang Fu thought it was an unexpected surprise and said happily: "Brother, you are here."
Zhang Anshi came to the bed and saw his "strange" posture lying on the bed, and couldn't help but sigh: "Third brother, you are suffering. As soon as I saw you being punished, I rushed home immediately to find a doctor for you."
When Zhang Fu heard this, tears welled up in his eyes: "My grandmother and my mother ignored me and justKnow how to scold me for not living up to expectations. When I was being whipped in the morning, I saw that my eldest brother was gone, and I thought that he didn't want to pay attention to me either. Who would have thought that eldest brother would actually care about my injury... eldest brother has me in his heart, I really..."
As he spoke, tears welled up in his eyes.
Zhang Anshi glanced at Zhang Fu sympathetically.
He seems to be a little stupid, but...he is a real person and can deal with it.
Zhang Anshi took out his porcelain bottle and said: "Although you have a skin injury, if it is infected, it will be fatal. This is the magic medicine I came for. You must remember to use it. Just apply it to the affected area. Do you understand? "
Zhang Fu looked touched and nodded like a chicken pecking rice: "If you come to see me, my injury will be half healed. I... I have no father, and my brother is strict with me. Only my eldest brother is kind to me. "
Zhang Anshi: "..."
Zhang Fu added: "Second brother has no loyalty and is still missing. "
Zhang Anshi comforted him and said: "Your second brother is different. He was also punished in school. I'm afraid his father will beat him when he gets home. He is being beaten now and he doesn't even care. "
After hearing this, Zhang Fu seemed to think it made sense, so he burst into tears and smiled: "Yes, I forgot..."
Zhang Anshi also told Zhang Fu to remember to take medicine, and said some unintelligible words about inflammation.
But Zhang Fu just chirped and hummed, and I don't know if he remembered it.
Zhang Anshi had no choice but to put the porcelain bottle containing the medicine aside.
But at this moment, two servants rushed in at the same time, one of them was Zhang San, and the other was Zhang Fu's book boy.
The two said in unison: "Zhang Tongzhi (the eldest young master) is here..."
Zhang Fu was so angry that he cursed: "It's coming when it's here. Why are you calling for mourning? Ouch, ouch..."
However, Zhang Anshi instinctively felt an emotion of fear, as if... the thing that Zhang Anshi had engraved in his bones had exploded, and he subconsciously said: "Brother, take care, I'll take the first step. "
Not daring to wait any longer, Zhang Anshi ran away quickly.
Zhang Fu was left with his mouth wide open, and he even forgot to hum.
Zhang Anshi didn't want to run away, he also wanted to maintain his glorious image as a man and a relative of the emperor.
But what's wrong with his legs is that they just won't obey his orders.
Zhang Fu was a famous general in the Yongle Dynasty in history. In addition, he had a bad temper and hated evil as much as he hated evil.
So, Zhang Anshi hurriedly left Zhang Fu's bedroom, and just as he was about to grab the door and escape, Zhang Fu's servant said: "You can't go this way, my eldest young master has already arrived in the front hall. "
"I'm not afraid of him. "Zhang Anshi cursed.
As he said this, he walked towards the side door. Unfortunately, this was an inner house. The so-called side door was actually closed and locked for many years. Zhang Anshi had no choice but to find a low wall and climb out.
I jumped down from the wall, but suddenly I heard someone shouting: "Where is the little thief? "
Zhang Anshi was still in shock and looked up in surprise, only to see a small group of people patrolling outside the wall.
The leader and the followers behind were all riding tall horses.
The strong man riding on the tall horse has a slightly dark complexion, a long beard, and a pair of eyes under a pair of silky eyebrows looking at Zixiong.
Zhang Anshi immediately said: "What does it have to do with you? "
After hearing this, the man on the horse became furious and waved his whip in his hand: "Take him down. "
The few followers behind were all very energetic and fierce, and they wanted to urge their horses forward.
Zhang Anshi immediately said: "I am not a little thief, I am a classmate of the boy in this house. He fell ill and I came to visit him. "
The eyes of the man on the horse were only slightly closed, and his whip was horizontal, stopping the movement of the followers behind him.
The person who came was none other than Zhu Di. Zhu Di felt quite uneasy. Originally he just wanted to give Zhang Fu a little pain, but when he heard that everyone was beaten to death, he realized that the attack might be a bit harsh.
He was the emperor who was about to conquer the world, but he didn't abide by any etiquette. He was anxious and put on plain clothes.Come out of the palace to visit.
When he passed by, he happened to see Zhang Anshi jumping over the wall.
Speaking of which, Zhu Di and Zhang Anshi can be considered relatives, but Zhu Di doesn't like Zhu Gaochi very much, and he doesn't have much love for Zhang Anshi, so naturally he has never met him.
Zhang Anshi looked like he was not a thief at first glance. After all, he climbed over the wall in broad daylight. Moreover, the young man had a fair complexion and was wearing silk and satin. He looked like a noble man at first glance. How could he be a thief?
Although Zhu Di's face darkened slightly, at this time, he became patient.
This person is a friend of Zhang Fu, and he has already inquired about his condition.
Zhu Di said: "Are you Zhang Fu's friend? What is your name?"
Zhang Anshi was not surprised when he saw Zhu Di casually mentioning Zhang Fu's name. The Zhang family was from Jingnan. Although Zhang Ying died in the battle, there were many nobles from Jingnan who had a close relationship with the Zhang family. The person in front of him... was probably one of them.
Zhang Anshi said: "Who else could it be? If I don't change my name at work or my surname at home, just call me Guo Degan."
Zhu Di searched in his mind whether Zhang Fu had such a classmate, but soon he lost his mind and asked, "How is Zhang Fu's injury?"
"He is my brother, Guo Degan, and he is naturally a tough guy. He should not die."
Zhu Di: "..."
